visual_identity.core_identity: The animated skeleton of a minotaur, preserving the horned bull skull and massive humanoid bone structure without flesh.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall skeletal humanoid frame topped by a broad horned bull skull, long bones, rib cage, and hooved or skeletal feet.
visual_identity.head_features: Large bovine skull with long muzzle cavity, empty eye sockets, and prominent curved horns.
visual_identity.body_shape: Heavy humanoid skeleton with broad rib cage and large limb bones, clearly larger than a human skeleton.
visual_identity.surface: Clean bone shapes with sparse cracks, no gore or hanging flesh.
signature_gear: simple damaged axe or labyrinth weapon
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one large bipedal minotaur skeleton: exactly one broad bull skull with long bovine muzzle and two sweeping horns, one exposed humanoid rib cage/spine, exactly two skeletal arms, and exactly two long skeletal legs ending in hoof-like skeletal feet. No flesh torso, human skull, goat skull, quadruped hindquarters, extra horns, or extra limbs.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly two skeletal humanoid arms and two bipedal skeletal legs beneath one horned bull skull; exposed ribs and spine connect the frame, with no centaur body, extra limbs, or fleshy replacement anatomy.

accuracy_checks: skeletal posture remains stable and readable

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: The animated skeleton of a minotaur, preserving the horned bull skull and massive humanoid bone structure without flesh. Heavy humanoid skeleton with broad rib cage and large limb bones, clearly larger than a human skeleton. Clean bone shapes with sparse cracks, no gore or hanging flesh.
